image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a jeweler's loupe (magnifying glass) resting on a reflective surface. The loupe has a metallic, copper-toned circular frame and a clear convex lens that reflects the surrounding environment with significant distortion due to magnification. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), showing indistinct shapes of what appear to be other jewelry tools or gems.
